title: ITV / Channel bumper sequence

location.extent: Whole original clip; PNG is one representative frame

slide_intent: Give channels distinct motion behaviours while returning each sequence to a recognizable name, because change over time can orient attention and distinguish channels.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen recognition and navigation across the network.
demonstration: The clip advances through ITV1 repetition, a dimensional pink ITV2 ribbon, blurred ITV3 lettering, angular green ITV4 forms and ITVBe circles and separated letters.
practical_value: Give channels distinct motion behaviours while returning each sequence to a recognizable name.

content_islands.name: ITV1
content_islands.spec: Numeral repetition produces depth across the frame.

content_islands.name: ITV2 and ITV3
content_islands.spec: Ribbon-like dimensional form contrasts with softened lettering.

content_islands.name: ITV4 and ITVBe
content_islands.spec: Angular green geometry contrasts with circles and movable Be letters.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip advances through ITV1 repetition, a dimensional pink ITV2 ribbon, blurred ITV3 lettering, angular green ITV4 forms and ITVBe circles and separated letters.
reference_purposes.Intent: The case-study section Bringing ITV to Life says motion adds energy and clarity, amplifies stories and guides audiences through the channel ecosystem.
